statement.ru: Синюю краску ультрамарин делали из полудрагоценного камня — лазурита.
statement.en: Ultramarine blue paint was made from a semi-precious stone, lapis lazuli.

why: Ultramarine was ground from lapis lazuli (its blue mineral lazurite).

statement.ru: Шрифт Helvetica назван в честь своего создателя.
statement.en: The Helvetica typeface is named after its creator.

why: False: Helvetica is Latin for 'Swiss'; its designer was Max Miedinger.

statement.ru: В «Менинах» Веласкес нарисовал среди придворных самого себя.
statement.en: In Las Meninas Velázquez painted himself among the courtiers.

why: Velázquez portrays himself at a large canvas behind the princess.

statement.ru: Знаменитая «Звёздная ночь» Ван Гога висит в Лувре.
statement.en: Van Gogh's famous The Starry Night hangs in the Louvre.

why: False: it has been at the Museum of Modern Art in New York since 1941.

statement.ru: Для «Американской готики» позировали сестра художника и его зубной врач.
statement.en: The models for American Gothic were the painter's sister and his dentist.

why: Grant Wood's sister Nan and the family dentist Byron McKeeby posed.

statement.ru: Прусскую синюю краску получили случайно, когда пытались сделать красную.
statement.en: Prussian blue was made by accident while trying to make a red dye.

why: Diesbach got blue when tainted potash spoiled his red cochineal dye.

statement.ru: Своё имя Микеланджело вырезал только на одной работе — «Пьете».
statement.en: Michelangelo carved his name on only one work, the Pietà.

why: Wikipedia: it is the only piece Michelangelo ever signed.

statement.ru: «Большую волну» Хокусай написал маслом на холсте.
statement.en: Hokusai painted The Great Wave in oil on canvas.

why: False: it is a woodblock print, and many copies exist.

statement.ru: Слово «граффити» пришло из английского языка.
statement.en: The word 'graffiti' comes from English.

why: False: from Italian graffiato, 'scratched'.

statement.ru: Художник Христо однажды целиком завернул в ткань здание Рейхстага.
statement.en: The artist Christo once wrapped the whole Reichstag building in fabric.

why: In 1995, with 100,000 m² of silvery fabric, for two weeks.

statement.ru: Бэтмен появился в комиксах раньше Супермена.
statement.en: Batman appeared in comics before Superman.

why: False: Batman debuted in 1939, created to cash in on Superman (1938).

statement.ru: Молодой Микеланджело состарил свою статую, чтобы продать её как античную.
statement.en: Young Michelangelo aged a statue of his to sell it as an antique.

why: His Sleeping Cupid was artificially aged to pass as ancient and fetch more money.

statement.ru: Свои рисунки в метро Нью-Йорка Кит Харинг делал баллончиком с краской.
statement.en: Keith Haring made his New York subway drawings with spray paint.

why: False: he drew in white chalk on empty black advertising panels.

statement.ru: Ярко-красную краску киноварь делали из минерала, в котором есть ртуть.
statement.en: Bright red vermilion paint was made from a mineral containing mercury.

why: Vermilion was ground cinnabar, mercury sulfide.

statement.ru: Первую в истории искусственную краску сделали ещё в Древнем Египте.
statement.en: The first man-made pigment in history was made in ancient Egypt.

why: Egyptian blue is considered the first synthetic pigment.

statement.ru: Тинтин из комиксов Эрже по профессии полицейский.
statement.en: Tintin from Hergé's comics is a policeman by trade.

why: False: Tintin is a young reporter.

statement.ru: Импрессионисты принципиально писали только в мастерской, а не на природе.
statement.en: The Impressionists painted only in the studio on principle, never outdoors.

why: False: they were known for painting outdoors, en plein air.

statement.ru: Жёлтую краску делали из мочи коров, которых кормили листьями манго.
statement.en: A yellow paint was made from the urine of cows fed on mango leaves.

why: Indian yellow; 2017-18 analyses confirmed the urine origin.

statement.ru: В Ренессанс ультрамарин был самой дешёвой синей краской.
statement.en: In the Renaissance ultramarine was the cheapest blue paint.

why: False: it was the most expensive blue, at times valued like gold.

statement.ru: Мангу читают справа налево.
statement.en: Manga is read from right to left.

why: Traditionally manga flows top to bottom and right to left.

statement.ru: Комиксы про Астерикса и Обеликса придумали в Бельгии.
statement.en: The Asterix and Obelix comics were created in Belgium.

why: False: Asterix is a French series by Goscinny and Uderzo.

statement.ru: Логотип «I ♥ NY» дизайнер нарисовал бесплатно.
statement.en: The designer drew the 'I ♥ NY' logo for free.

why: Milton Glaser did the work pro bono, sketching it in a taxi.

statement.ru: Человека-паука в первых комиксах рисовал сам Стэн Ли.
statement.en: Stan Lee himself drew the first Spider-Man comics.

why: False: Lee wrote them; artist Steve Ditko drew them.

statement.ru: Охру, одну из древнейших красок, делали из цветочных лепестков.
statement.en: Ochre, one of the oldest paints, was made from flower petals.

why: False: ochre is a natural clay earth pigment coloured by iron oxide.

statement.ru: В Вене есть музей, где выставлены одни подделки.
statement.en: Vienna has a museum that shows nothing but art fakes.

why: The Museum of Art Fakes, opened in Vienna in 2005.

statement.ru: На картине Босха есть ноты, написанные на чьих-то ягодицах.
statement.en: A Bosch painting shows sheet music written on someone's buttocks.

why: In the Musicians' Hell a choir sings from a score on a pair of buttocks.

statement.ru: Уорхол нарисовал 32 банки супа — по числу вкусов, которые тогда продавали.
statement.en: Warhol painted 32 soup cans, one for each flavour then on sale.

why: MoMA: 32 canvases, the number of soup varieties Campbell's then sold, each a different one.

statement.ru: Огромную скульптуру «Боб» в Чикаго отлили из стекла.
statement.en: Chicago's giant 'Bean' sculpture is made of glass.

why: False: Cloud Gate is 168 welded stainless steel plates.

statement.ru: Любимая еда кота Гарфилда — рыба.
statement.en: Garfield the cat's favourite food is fish.

why: False: Garfield is famous for his love of lasagna.

statement.ru: Один художник писал портреты, составленные из фруктов и овощей.
statement.en: One painter made portraits out of fruit and vegetables.

why: Arcimboldo built heads from fruit, vegetables, flowers and fish.

statement.ru: Голову Ники Самофракийской нашли и приставили к статуе.
statement.en: The head of the Winged Victory of Samothrace was found and put back on.

why: False: the head and arms are missing; searches failed to find the head.

statement.ru: Джунгли для своих картин Анри Руссо видел в парижском ботаническом саду.
statement.en: Henri Rousseau saw the jungles for his paintings in a Paris botanical garden.

why: He never travelled; he studied plants and animals in Paris's museum and gardens.

statement.ru: Шрифт Times New Roman создали для компьютеров.
statement.en: The Times New Roman typeface was made for computers.

why: False: it was commissioned by The Times newspaper in 1931.

statement.ru: Жёлтый смайлик нарисовали за десять минут и заплатили за него 45 долларов.
statement.en: The yellow smiley face was drawn in ten minutes for a fee of $45.

why: Harvey Ball drew it in 1963 in ten minutes and was paid $45.

statement.ru: «Девушку с жемчужной серёжкой» однажды купили на аукционе всего за пару гульденов.
statement.en: Girl with a Pearl Earring was once bought at auction for just a couple of guilders.

why: In 1881 it sold in The Hague for two guilders plus 30 cents premium.

statement.ru: «Мыслитель» Родена высечен из мрамора.
statement.en: Rodin's The Thinker is carved from marble.

why: False: The Thinker is a bronze sculpture, cast many times.

statement.ru: Французский музей выяснил, что больше половины его картин — подделки.
statement.en: A French museum found that more than half of its paintings were fakes.

why: The Terrus Museum in Elne: 82 of 140 works were fakes (2018).

statement.ru: Ван Гог написал «Подсолнухи» в единственном экземпляре.
statement.en: Van Gogh painted his Sunflowers only once.

why: False: Sunflowers is two series with several versions.

statement.ru: Мозаику уличного художника повесили на Международной космической станции.
statement.en: A street artist's mosaic was put up on the International Space Station.

why: Invader's 'Space2' was installed on the ISS Columbus module in 2015.

statement.ru: Леонардо закончил «Мону Лизу» за несколько недель.
statement.en: Leonardo finished the Mona Lisa in a few weeks.

why: False: he worked on it from 1503 for years, maybe until 1517.

statement.ru: На самом первом логотипе Apple был нарисован Ньютон под деревом.
statement.en: Apple's very first logo showed Newton under a tree.

why: Ron Wayne's first logo depicts Isaac Newton under an apple tree.
